findings.content: Weak claim/burn finalization cannot roll back an applied native transaction; existing F-01 recovery gate remains open.
Existing root plus leftover pending is returned as claimed after bootstrap; SDK reports recoveryRequired for the same snapshot.
maxFeeDrops checks only an input Fee; wallet-filled over-limit fees are accepted when Fee was omitted.
Mainnet-configured clients still receive testnet-only funding and wallet instructions.
